uninstall.removal.restorePoint.title: Create a System Restore point first
uninstall.removal.restorePoint.preflight: A System Restore point is created first. There is no undo for the vendor step — recovery is the restore point, or reinstalling.
uninstall.removal.restorePoint.unavailab: No System Restore point can be created here (it needs admin, and System Restore must be on). A .reg backup is still taken before each registry delete and files still go to the Recycle Bin.
uninstall.removal.restorePoint.name: Windows Care Kit — before uninstalling {0}
uninstall.removal.honest: A .reg backup is taken before each registry delete and files go to the Recycle Bin. Neither depends on System Restore.
uninstall.removal.confirm.body: The vendor step cannot be unchecked. Check any leftover you also want removed — nothing runs until you approve.
